Alex G: hey team — first week q: how do I get Vault/KMS access to fetch dev API keys? not sure which form to fill. also who owns rotation for service account keys?
Sam (DevEx): welcome! quick answer: fill the access request form and attach manager approval. dev-access is usually vault-read; prod/KMS needs extra steps. link below.
Irene - EngSec: hi Alex — onboarding checklist: we grant vault dev read by default for new hires after the form. for production secrets + KMS you need manager sign-off + sso group. KMS for customer data requires 2-person review. i'll DM you the checklist.
Ben I: if this is a service account we recommend short-lived roles via Vault AppRole or AWS IAM role. persistent creds need infra ticket + a rotation cadence (we prefer 30 days).
Maya P: also add your team channel in the form (helps approvals). HR/manager attestation is required for initial prod access.
Alex G: thanks! what's the exact form link? and are rotations automated or manual?
Sam (DevEx): form: https://redwood.internal/tools/request-vault (internal). rotations: we have key-rotation-service (KRS) for some secret types. others rely on owner-run rotation with reminders.
oncall-bot: INFO: key-rotation-service next run scheduled 2024-05-02T03:00:00Z
Irene - EngSec: rotation basics: we use kv v2. owners should set metadata.rotate=true and attach a one-line runbook. example: `vault kv put secret/team-xyz/api key=VALUE metadata.rotate=true runbook="https://redwood.internal/runbooks/team-xyz/rotate-api"`
Irene - EngSec: also: if you store creds in cloud KMS, make sure the KMS key is in the correct customer/key ring and has a service account with least privilege. we require audit logging enabled for prod keys.
Alex G: ok i'll open the form now. if my manager is OOO, who can approve?
Maya P: put a fallback approver (team lead) in the form. for emergency access sec-leads can temporarily approve, but they will follow up with manager later.
Ben I: :thumbsup: if you want i can walk you through creating an AppRole for your service account.
Alex G: that would be awesome, thanks — appreciate the quick responses :raised_hands:
Sam (DevEx): tagging the internal docs in case others land here: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/secrets-onboarding and the quick-checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/vault-quickstart
Alex G: bookmarked. i'll follow up if i hit any errors when submitting. :)
